title: The tree that configures the fleet
dek: Chromium's CI is 1,211 builders in 18 buckets, all of them generated by lucicfg from 125 Starlark files inside the repository they build. This is how a change gets from git cl upload to refs/heads/main, how 2.4 million test tasks a day get scheduled, and how a milestone turns into a branch, a version bump and a release.
byline: 22 September 2026 · Subject: chromium/src@f288fed6 (156.0.8067.0), depot_tools@0306e468 and v8@15.6.0 (standalone; this Chromium pins 15.6.19)
description: Chromium's 1,211 builders, its commit queue and its release branches are all generated by lucicfg from 125 Starlark files in the tree.
og_description: A teardown of Chromium's CI/CD: the LUCI stack, infra/config Starlark and the generated cfgs, tests on bots, bot_update, the commit queue, tree closers and gardeners, the two-week release cycle and the release scripts.
twitter_description: 1,211 builders generated from 125 Starlark files. How Chromium builds, tests and ships — from git cl upload to refs/branch-heads.
